description: Check London's air with London Air, the London Air Quality Network run by Imperial College London: the hourly and daily air quality index of every monitoring site in the city's boroughs, from Low to Very High, with health advice, hourly measurements of nitrogen dioxide, ozone, particulate matter and more back to 1993, and each site's yearly results, and run a workflow when the index reaches a level. No account or API key required.

london_air_air_quality_index_reached_tri.description: Triggers when the hourly air quality index (1 for low pollution to 10 for very high) of a site, a local authority or all of London rises to the band you choose: Moderate, High or Very High. It triggers once on the way up, and again only after the index has dropped under the band. Air already in that band when you turn it on doesn't trigger it until it clears and comes back.
